related.title: rsync：區塊差異與可重算傳輸預算
related.titleEn: rsync: block differences and reproducible transfer budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付archive-layout.csv與安全路徑分類；執行lab僅用合成記錄，不解壓未知封存檔。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver archive-layout.csv and path classifications; the lab uses synthetic records without extracting unknown archives. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 為每塊計hash與offset，列可重用及需傳送區段；重建後再核對整檔hash。
related.differenceEn: Hash each block with its offset, mark reuse and transfer spans, then verify the reconstructed whole-file hash.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
tar以512 B記錄對齊，檔案header與payload padding須分開；還原路徑需要拒絕越出目的目錄的名稱。
本課數值核對：512+ceil(1000/512)*512 = 1536 B；另一項核對：1536+2*512 = 2560 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

區塊簽章協助尋找重複內容；真正rsync還有rolling checksum與協定開銷。固定區塊練習只展示差異傳輸的取捨。
本課數值核對：3*4096 = 12288 B；另一項核對：1-3/256 = 0.98828125 saved_fraction。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
tar aligns records to512 bytes; distinguish headers from payload padding. Extraction must reject names escaping the destination.
Numeric audit: 512+ceil(1000/512)*512 = 1536 B; second audit: 1536+2*512 = 2560 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Block signatures identify reusable content; real rsync also has rolling checksums and protocol overhead. The fixed-block exercise illustrates only transfer tradeoffs.
Numeric audit: 3*4096 = 12288 B; second audit: 1-3/256 = 0.98828125 saved_fraction. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Trace send, receive, close and blocked events, separating occupancy from cumulative completed items.

channel傳遞與同步關聯，buffer容量限制未消費項目；關閉是發送方生命周期事件，不是任意一個consumer的清理捷徑。
本課數值核對：5-2 = 3 items；另一項核對：3+1 = 4 items。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Numeric audit: 512+ceil(1000/512)*512 = 1536 B; second audit: 1536+2*512 = 2560 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Channels couple communication and synchronization; capacity bounds unconsumed values. Closing belongs to sender lifecycle, not arbitrary consumer cleanup.
Numeric audit: 5-2 = 3 items; second audit: 3+1 = 4 items. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
